Likelihood Ratio Test to Detect Triggering

Source: R/hawkes_trigger_lrt.R
hawkes_trigger_lrt.Rd

Likelihood Ratio Test to Detect Triggering

Usage

hawkes_trigger_lrt(hawkes, parameters, alpha = 0.05)

Arguments

hawkes

A hawkes object.

parameters

Parameter values stored in a named list or a hawkes_fit object from hawkes_mle().

alpha

Type-1 error rate for the hypothesis test. Defaults to 0.05 if unused.

Value

A tibble

Examples

spatial_region <- create_rectangular_sf(0, 10, 0, 10)

params <- list(
  background_rate = list(intercept = -4),
  triggering_rate = 0.01,
  spatial = list(mean = 0, sd = 0.5),
  temporal = list(rate = 1)
)
hawkes <- rHawkes(
  params = params,
  time_window = c(0, 100),
  spatial_region = spatial_region,
  background_process = ~ 1
)
#> Error in rHawkes(params = params, time_window = c(0, 100), spatial_region = spatial_region,     background_process = ~1): unused argument (background_process = ~1)
est <- hawkes_mle(hawkes, ~ 1, inits = params)
#> Error in hawkes_mle(hawkes, ~1, inits = params): hawkes must be a hawkes object
hawkes_trigger_lrt(hawkes, est)
#> Error in rep(1, nrow(hawkes)): invalid 'times' argument


params <- list(
  background_rate = list(intercept = -4.5, X1 = 1, X2 = 1),
  triggering_rate = 0.1,
  spatial = list(mean = 0, sd = 0.25),
  temporal = list(rate = 2),
  fixed = list(spatial = "mean")
)
data("example_background_covariates")
hawkes <- rHawkes(
  params = params,
  time_window = c(0, 50),
  spatial_region = example_background_covariates,
  background_process = ~ X1 + X2,
  spatial_burnin = 1
)
#> Error in rHawkes(params = params, time_window = c(0, 50), spatial_region = example_background_covariates,     background_process = ~X1 + X2, spatial_burnin = 1): unused argument (background_process = ~X1 + X2)
est <- hawkes_mle(hawkes, ~ X1 + X2, inits = params, boundary = 1)
#> Error in hawkes_mle(hawkes, ~X1 + X2, inits = params, boundary = 1): hawkes must be a hawkes object
hawkes_trigger_lrt(hawkes, est)
#> Error in rep(1, nrow(hawkes)): invalid 'times' argument
